item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow morning. It will be windy over the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a continental airstream, it will be mainly fine and dry with relatively large temperature difference between day and night over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 24/11 (Friday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming east force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
